source_item.title: Let's Encrypt CP/CPS Missing Chrome Root Program Attestation
source_item.description: Let's Encrypt became aware its CP/CPS lacked the required attestation of compliance with the Chrome Root Program Policy and CCADB Policy by the 2026-06-15 effective date. Community discussion (as of Aug 10-12, 2026) is debating whether this triggers mandated certificate revocation under Chrome/CCADB policy. This could constitute a mass-revocation event affecting Let's Encrypt-issued certificates; needs verification of resolution/remediation timeline and whether revocation is mandated.

correction.reason: All five channels stated that mandated revocation was an open question. That framing was already false when written: Let's Encrypt answered the revocation question on the record on 2026-08-18, two days before this package was generated. The source_item above is preserved unedited as the record of what the pipeline emitted; it is NOT a citable source. Use corrected_provenance_urls and corrected_description below.
correction.corrected_description: Let's Encrypt disclosed on 2026-08-10 that its CP/CPS lacked an explicit attestation of compliance with the latest Chrome Root Program Policy and CCADB Policy, required by 2026-06-15 under Section 1.1.3 of Chrome Root Program Policy v1.8. No certificate revocation follows: Let's Encrypt stated on 2026-08-18 that a CPS in violation of requirements 'does not affect the trust status of any certificates.' A CP/CPS document defect is not a certificate defect. Subscribers need take no action on their Let's Encrypt inventory. No deadline is created, changed or removed by this item; the only date in the story, 2026-06-15, is past and CA-side.
correction.bugzilla_correction: The incident report is Bugzilla 2062418 ('Let's Encrypt: CPS missing root program attestation'), named in the Let's Encrypt disclosure itself. The 2038351 in source_item.provenance_urls is the WRONG BUG - it is the unrelated Gen Y cross-certified subordinate CAs missing serverAuth EKU incident from 2026-05-08. Do not cite 2038351 for this story.
correction.urgent_flag_correction: source_item.urgent is true and that is what caused this package to be drafted at all. The item is not urgent: it carries no subscriber action and no date certain. Retained as-is for pipeline provenance only.
correction.deadline_impact: none - no deadline entry added, changed or removed; pki_compliance_mcp.py untouched
correction.sources_verified: Both Let's Encrypt threads fetched and read directly on 2026-08-20; bug number 2062418 read verbatim from the 2026-08-10 disclosure.
